description: This file implements a logging utility for the HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer) in C. It handles formatted log messages, manages log level output, and controls extended logging features based on environment variables or the presence of a specific file. It includes initialization and termination functions executed upon library load and unload.

methods.name: void HALUTIL_Logger_Message(eMessageLevel level,const char * function,int line,const char * format,...)
methods.description: Logs a formatted message with specified log level, function name, and line number.

methods.name: void HALUTIL_LogModuleInit()
methods.description: Initializes logging module, evaluates environment or file-based flags for extended logging.

methods.name: void HALUTIL_LogModuleTerminate()
methods.description: Terminates logging module, logs termination message.
